details: Walking Aids Recommended: Navigating the stone temple courtyards (Prakarams) and long flight of stone steps down to the Godavari riverbank can be physically demanding; walking sticks are advised.

Lightweight Folding Stool Recommended: Long queues during peak hours (1 to 2.5 hours on Saturdays/Tuesdays) or waiting times at the Godavari ghats can be tiring. Carrying a small lightweight folding stool is strongly recommended for senior citizens.
Thick Cotton Socks: Protects feet against intense afternoon heat radiation from the sun-baked stone temple courtyards while complying with ritual purity.
Medication Buffer: Pilgrims should carry a 2-day extra supply of BP, diabetes, or daily prescription medications, as specific brands may not be stocked locally in town.
